title: Diff adds `import gleam/option` to vacancy_api.gleam but never uses it (compiler warning)
evidence: Line 9: `import gleam/option`. `gleam check` output: "warning: Unused imported module ┌─ client/src/api/vacancy_api.gleam:9:1 │ 9 │ import gleam/option │ ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ This imported module is never used". grep confirms no `option.` usage anywhere in the file (only `decode.optional_field`, which comes from gleam/dynamic/decode).
detail: The diff's only added import in this file is dead — the new decoder uses decode.optional_field, not the option module. Emits a warning on every client build; absent at the baseline commit.

title: Spec verification command `node --test scripts/js-tests/` fails on the repo's Node (v22.22.0)
evidence: Spec line 106: "- `node --test scripts/js-tests/` — expected: payload/disambiguation tests pass". Running it: "Error: Cannot find module '/Users/moses/.herdr/worktrees/RightTenantry/perkins-form-funnel-w0-r1/scripts/js-tests' … code: 'MODULE_NOT_FOUND'". The wired commands use the glob form and pass all 25 tests: Makefile:403 `node --test scripts/js-tests/*.test.js` and package.json:8 `"test:js": "node --test scripts/js-tests/*.test.js"`.
detail: The bare-directory invocation documented in the spec errors out instead of running tests; anyone copy-pasting the verification command gets a false failure. Only the glob form works on Node 22.22.0.
recommended_fix: Change the spec's verification line to `node --test scripts/js-tests/*.test.js` (or `make test-js`) to match the working wired commands.

title: format_close_date/month_name in email_client.gleam is a third copy of audit_report's date formatter
evidence: email_client.gleam:264 `pub fn format_close_date(closes_at: String) -> String {` and :284 `fn month_name(month: Int) -> String {` duplicate server/src/ai/audit_report.gleam:308 `fn format_iso_date_long(ts: String) -> String {` (same ≥10-char slice, split on "-", "13 August 2026" output, raw fallback) and :331 `fn month_name(n: Int) -> Option(String) {`. server/src/ai/evidence_humanize.gleam:403 already carries a second copy with the comment "// `month_name` is duplicated from `audit_report.month_name`".
detail: The new helper re-implements existing month-name/long-date logic now living in three modules; the established pattern (evidence_humanize) at least acknowledges the duplication in a comment, this copy doesn't.
recommended_fix: Either extract a shared date-format helper module, or add a comment noting the duplication per the evidence_humanize precedent.
